Metal-Poor Populations in 47 Tucanae (NGC 104) Based on observations made with the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) 1 m telescope, which is operated by the SMARTS consortium. This work prese
arxiv-2210-12332.creator: Jae-Woo Lee
arxiv-2210-12332.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jae-Woo Lee. We present new large field-of-view ( ∼ \sim 1° × \times 1°) Ca-CN photometry of the prototypical metal-rich globular cluster 47 Tucanae (NGC 104). Our results are the following. (1) The populational number ratios of the red giant branch (RGB) and red horizontal branch (RHB) are in excellent agreement: n n (CN-w): n n (CN-s) = 30:70 ( ± \pm 1–2), where the CN-w and CN-s stand for the CN-weak and CN-strong populations, respectively.

arxiv-2405-07842.title: Ground-based image deconvolution with Swin Transformer UNet
arxiv-2405-07842.creator: U. Akhaury, P. Jablonka, J.-L. Starck, F. Courbin
arxiv-2405-07842.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by U. Akhaury, P. Jablonka, J.-L. Starck, F. Courbin. As ground-based all-sky astronomical surveys will gather millions of images in the coming years, a critical requirement emerges for the development of fast deconvolution algorithms capable of efficiently improving the spatial resolution of these images. By successfully recovering clean and high-resolution images from these surveys, the objective is to deepen the understanding of galaxy formation and evolution through accurate photometric measurements. We introduce a two-step deconvolution framework using a Swin Transformer architecture.

arxiv-2406-15558.title: Rapid Multi-band Space-Based Optical Timing: Revolutionizing Accretion Physics
arxiv-2406-15558.creator: Krista Lynne Smith 1,∗
arxiv-2406-15558.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Krista Lynne Smith 1,∗. Optical timing with rapid, seconds-to-minutes cadences with high photometric precision and gap-free long baselines is necessary for an unambiguous physical picture of accretion phenomena, and is only possible from space. Exoplanet-hunting missions like Kepler and TESS have offered an outstanding new window into detailed jet and accretion physics, but have been severely hampered by incomplete calibration and systematics treatments and, most especially, a monochromatic single wide bandpass.

arxiv-2410-15289.title: Automatic verification of Finite Variant Property beyond convergent equational theories Thanks: This work received funding from the France 2030 program managed by the French National Research Agency under grant agreement No. ANR-22-PECY-0006.
arxiv-2410-15289.creator: Vincent Cheval, Caroline Fontaine
arxiv-2410-15289.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vincent Cheval, Caroline Fontaine. Computer-aided analysis of security protocols heavily relies on equational theories to model cryptographic primitives. Most automated verifiers for security protocols focus on equational theories that satisfy the Finite Variant Property (FVP) , for which solving unification is decidable. However, they either require to prove FVP by hand or at least to provide a representation as an E E -convergent rewrite system, usually E E being at most the equational theory for an associative and commutative function symbol (AC).

arxiv-2411-13839.title: Theoretical Studies on the Evolution of Solar Filaments in Response to New Emerging Flux
arxiv-2411-13839.creator: Yuhao Chen, Jialiang Hu, Guanchong Cheng, Jing Ye, Zhixing Mei, Chengcai Shen, Jun Lin
arxiv-2411-13839.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuhao Chen, Jialiang Hu, Guanchong Cheng, Jing Ye, Zhixing Mei, Chengcai Shen, Jun Lin. New emerging flux (NEF) has long been considered a mechanism for solar eruptions, but detailed process remains an open question. In this work, we explore how NEF drives a coronal magnetic configuration to erupt.

pmc-10672849.title: Electrospun PCL Wires Loaded with Vancomycin on Zirconium Substrate
pmc-10672849.creator: Ramona-Daniela Radu (Dusman), Manuela Elena Voicu, Mariana Prodana, Ioana Demetrescu, Valentina Anuta, Doina Draganescu
pmc-10672849.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The current study presents research about electrodeposition in relation to electrospinning PCL wires on a Zr substrate and loading the coating with vancomycin. The structural composition of the coatings was investigated via FT-IR analysis. pmc-12608248.title: Evaluation and Control of Variability in RAP Properties Through Refined Fractionation Processing Methods
pmc-12608248.creator: Yan Zhang, Jiyang Li, Yiren Sun, Giovanni Polacco
pmc-12608248.description: Variability in reclaimed asphalt pavement (RAP) properties, such as aggregate gradation, asphalt content, and moisture content, poses a significant challenge to producing consistent and reliable recycled asphalt mixtures. This study systematically evaluated processing techniques for mitigating variability through a comparative analysis of four fractionation strategies, i.e., unfractionated, two-fraction, four-fraction, and six-fraction processing.

pmc-12984168.creator: Avraham Eisbruch, M. P. Sreeram, Karthik Rao, Abbas Agaimy, Luiz P. Kowalski, Andrés Coca Pelaz, Anna Luíza Damaceno Araújo, Orlando Guntinas-Lichius, Juan P. Rodrigo, Fernando Lopez, Sandra Nuyts, Nabil F. Saba, Arlene Forastiere, Carol R. Bradford, Alfio Ferlito
pmc-12984168.description: Backgrounds: Single-arm studies evaluating reduced intensity (de-escalated) therapy for low-risk Human Papillomavirus-related oropharyngeal cancer (HPV+OPC) patients demonstrated high cure rates and reduced toxicity compared with historical results of standard of care (SOC). However, randomized studies demonstrated that the outcomes of de-escalated therapies were inferior to standard therapy, suggesting that a minority of patients may not benefit from de-escalation.

pmc-13255302.title: Palliative care for the people without medical insurance in Germany: an empirical ethical approach
pmc-13255302.creator: Matthias Zimmer, Antonia Sahm
pmc-13255302.description: BackgroundPeople without medical insurance often lack access to medical care, increasing their risk of chronic diseases and reducing life expectancy. This disparity likely extends to end-of-life care, when patients are especially vulnerable. The main research question was whether outpatient and inpatient palliative care facilities regularly treat uninsured patients.

pmc-13363335.description: Background:Many strides have been made in the field of vascular composite allotransplantation, and some vascular composite allotransplantation procedures, including upper extremity and facial transplantation, are arguably nearing the standard of care for adult recipients.
